sections.title: The problem
sections.body:
Marketers and business owners in Bandar Lampung have few places to learn current practices and meet peers. Most high-quality marketing events happen in Jakarta.

The IMA chapter brings that knowledge and network closer to home.

items.title: Knowledge-sharing events
items.description: Talks and panels with practitioners on branding, digital marketing, and sales.

items.title: Networking meetups
items.description: Regular gatherings that connect marketers, business owners, and students.

items.title: Support for local businesses
items.description: Sessions that help small businesses apply practical marketing.

sections.body: The chapter has become a meeting point for the local marketing community, with members collaborating beyond events.
